input.quote: and shall be terminable thereafter by agreement of the Parties. However, any Party may terminate its participation in this Agreement at the end of the Initial Period or any time thereafter by giving not less than one (1) year's prior notice thereof, in writing, to the other Parties.
input.rationale: Clause 18 sets a single 25-year Initial Period running from the RFS Date, after which the Agreement continues in operation and is terminable "thereafter by agreement of the Parties" (18.1), with termination during the Initial Period by written agreement of all Parties (18.2) and post-Initial-Period decommissioning by a two-thirds voting-interest agreement (18.3). There is no automatic renewal, no renewal term length, no non-renewal notice window and no renewal price-uplift mechanic anywhere in the document, so each conditional automatic-renewal element (12-month renewal term, 30-day opt-out, 60-day reminder, CPI/3% or 5% uplift cap) is inapplicable; continuation past the Initial Period rests on agreement of the Parties rather than a unilateral roll-over, which sits at or above the preferred position. The one year's written notice in 18.1 is our own unilateral exit right, exercisable at the end of the Initial Period or any time thereafter, so it benefits us and is an exit mechanic rather than a non-renewal notice window; it is not redlined and is not double-flagged under the termination rules. We note only for completeness that, because no renewal pricing exists, there is nothing to cap - a drafting note, not a fallback failure.
